notes: m21-fidelity (adversarial gate, 2026-10-29). Printed: 'You may play two additional lands on each of your turns.' A static ability (CR 305.2: effects may allow additional land plays; 604.1): with Azusa on the battlefield the turn's land allowance is 1 + 2, so three land drops succeed and the fourth is refused, with no activation. Before the fix the sentence compiled to a free activated ability (cost {}), so nothing was granted until it was activated, and every activation added two more (the gate measured 0 -> 2 -> 4 -> 6).
